summary: Cyclerion Therapeutics filed an 8-K solely to set a record date of September 4, 2026 for its previously announced distribution of contingent value rights (CVRs) to common and Series A Preferred stockholders. The CVR distribution is tied to Cyclerion's planned merger with Korsana Biosciences. The filing provides no financial terms (price, premium, CVR value) or board recommendation. Structural notes are limited to the record date, payment timing remains undisclosed, and transferability, registration, and listing status of the CVRs are cited as anticipated terms subject to risk factors — all pending shareholder approval and financing. What to watch: updated merger agreement terms and definitive CVR payout conditions, plus the shareholder vote and financing close timeline.
